extensionAttribute.description: Returns the DNS/IP of the Adobe Update Server configured via AAMUpdater overrides.
extensionAttribute.scriptContentsMac:
#!/bin/zsh
# Updated by SecurityShrimp 2026 # Adobe Update Server Extension Attribute # Targets macOS 12 through 26 (Tahoe) # Adobe still ships overrides at the AAMUpdater path on Creative Cloud.
cfg="/Library/Application Support/Adobe/AAMUpdater/1.0/AdobeUpdater.Overrides"
if [[ -f "$cfg" ]]; then server=$(/usr/bin/grep -m1 "Domain" "$cfg" \ | /usr/bin/sed -E 's/<[^>]*>//g; s|https?://||g' \ | /usr/bin/awk '{print $1}') echo "<result>${server:-Not Set}</result>" else echo "<result>No Adobe Update Server Set</result>" fi
